blog.faqSubtitle: Common questions about our blog and renovation guides
blog.faqQ1: What renovation services does Reno Stars offer?
blog.faqA1: Reno Stars offers kitchen, bathroom, basement, whole-house, and commercial renovations. Services include cabinet refacing, Poly-B pipe replacement, heat pump installation, and accessible bathroom renovations.
blog.faqQ2: How much does a renovation cost in Metro Vancouver?
blog.faqA2: Kitchen renovations in Vancouver typically range from $30,000–$80,000+. Bathroom renovations range from $20,000–$60,000+. Basement renovations for legal suites start around $50,000.
